args.expression: (()=>{const f=[...document.querySelectorAll('.field')].find(e=>/assigned user/i.test(e.querySelector('.cell-label,label')?.innerText||''));const ac=document.querySelector('.autocomplete');return JSON.stringify({assigneeField: f?{vis:!!f.offsetParent, cls:f.className, html:f.innerText.slice(0,200), inputs:[...f.querySelectorAll('input')].map(i=>({n:i.name,cls:i.className,v:i.value}))}:null, anyAutocomplete: ac?{cls:ac.className,txt:ac.innerText.slice(0,200),vis:!!ac.offsetParent}:null, bodyAC:[...document.querySelectorAll('body > .autocomplete, body > div.autocomplete')].map(e=>e.className)})})()

(()=>{const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('span.label-text')].filter(e=>/Assigned User/i.test(e.innerText));const r=els[0].closest('.form-group');const cont=r.closest('.panel');return JSON.stringify({panelCls:cont.className, panelId:cont.id, panelVisible:!!cont.offsetParent, formGroupText:r.innerText.slice(0,200), inputs:[...r.querySelectorAll('input,button')].map(i=>({tag:i.tagName,n:i.name,cls:i.className,v:i.value,txt:i.innerText.slice(0,40)}))})})()

(()=>{const els=[...document.querySelectorAll('span.label-text')].filter(e=>/Assigned User/i.test(e.innerText));const r=els[0].closest('.form-group');const panel=r.closest('.panel');const body=panel.querySelector('.panel-body');return JSON.stringify({labelsInSamePanel:[...body.querySelectorAll('span.label-text')].map(s=>s.innerText.trim()), middleCls:panel.closest('.middle')?panel.closest('.middle').className:'no-middle', parentChain:(()=>{let p=panel;const c=[];for(let i=0;i<5&&p;i++){c.push(p.tagName+'.'+String(p.className).slice(0,80));p=p.parentElement}return c})()})})()
